mapper.select: select /* SYS10000MMapper.selectLoginPassword */ cu.password , cu.user_yn , cu.lock_yn from com_user cu where cu.user_id = #{USER_ID}

select /* SYS10000MMapper.selectLoginUserInfo */ nvl(#{LANG_CD}, 'KO') as lang_cd , cuiv.user_id , cuiv.user_nm , cuiv.emp_id , cuiv.emp_num , cuiv.emp_nm , cuiv.company_cd , cuiv.company_nm , cuiv.dept_cd , cuiv.dept_nm , cuiv.grade_cd , cuiv.grade_nm , cuiv.job_cd , cuiv.job_nm , cuiv.position_cd , cuiv.position_nm , cuiv.hire_date , cuiv.retire_date , cuiv.supervisor_emp_id , cuiv.supervisor_emp_num , cuiv.supervisor_emp_nm from com_user_info_v cuiv where cuiv.user_id = #{USER_ID}
select /* SYS10000MMapper.selectProfileList */ sp.profile_cd , sp.profile_name , sp.profile_value from sys_profile sp where sp.profile_cd = 'MDI_TAB_MAX_CNT' order by sp.profile_cd
